package main // Card keeps an employer as tracked server state: its fields, nested // fields and methods read through the Assign, and writes into it update // it. type Card struct { employer Employer } func (p *Card) Load(name, city string) { p.employer.Name = name p.employer.Addr.City = city p.employer.Tags[0] = "new" } // Rename calls the record's pointer methods: each a write into it. func (p *Card) Rename(name string) { p.employer.Rename(name) p.employer.Addr.Fix() } func (p *Card) Title() string { return "Employer " + p.employer.Name + " of " + p.employer.Addr.City }

{employer.Name}

{employer.Addr.City}, {employer.Label()}
